The Design Studio

The build is only half the story. Then comes the feeling.

Every McMackin project can include full interior design through JDID, the studio founded by Jamie and Dougie. While Nick's crew handles the structure, JDID handles the soul: color palettes, space planning, hand-painted murals, custom art, and the collected details that make a house feel like yours.

One team, one conversation. Your builder and your designer working from the same plan, so nothing gets lost between the vision and the reality.

We don't just renovate houses. We create homes that feel collected, lived in, and uniquely yours.
